text: there is no mention of or reference to Jesus Christ anywhere in the Hebrew Bible hey everybody I'm Dan mclen I'm a scholar of the Bible and religion Jesus
didn't exist anywhere near the composition of the texts of the Hebrew Bible now the authors of the texts of the New Testament and specifically the
gospels told stories about Jesus in ways that were specifically designed to reflect 1 Century
CE understandings of what was expected by the original authors and audiences of those texts that can be understood to
have a Messianic expectation but there's no case to make that those authors and
audiences expected precisely what we find in the life and the mission of Jesus of Nazareth the only case that can
be made is that the Hebrew Bible plausibly leaves conceptual space to negotiate Jesus into some of those
Messianic expectations Jesus can only be found by negotiating Jesus into the text Jesus is not native to the text and this
is one of the main differences between a critical approach to understanding the Hebrew Bible and an apologetic approach a critical approach does its best to try
to identify and then leave aside the later conceptual Frameworks and interpretive lenses to try to reconstruct the lenses and the
Frameworks of the original authors and audiences so we can most closely approximate what they most lik understood by their text an apologetic
approach is not interested in what they most likely understood an apologetic approach is interested in finding their
ideologies and dogmas in the text and so it must navigate around the data and find conceptual space to negotiate those
dogmas in and say the data do not preclude us from finding what we want in the text the data do not make it
impossible that what we want to find could have been intended but if we prioritize what the authors and
audiences understood by these texts then Jesus of Nazareth is not found anywhere in the Hebrew Bible
